onboarding.headline: Star in today's trends
onboarding.sub: Add a few selfies once. Then tap any template and get a vertical video of you in about a minute.
onboarding.step3: Share to TikTok, Reels or Shorts
onboarding.terms: I accept the Terms of Use, Privacy Policy and Community Guidelines

discover.createProfile: Create your face profile to start

identity.title: Your face profile
identity.explain: Pick 5–10 clear photos of yourself: different angles, good light, only you in the frame.
identity.consent: These photos show me, or I have the explicit permission of the person shown.

job.title: Your video
job.notifyHint: You can leave this screen — we'll keep working on it.
job.reported: Thanks — our team will review it.

multi.title: Your video, new faces
multi.intro: Upload a clip you own. We'll find up to {{max}} people so you can choose who to replace with your face profiles.
multi.rights: I own this video or have the rights to use it.
multi.consent: Everyone whose face will be replaced has agreed to it.
multi.notSelectable: Can't replace (face too small or not visible)

profile.deleteConfirm: This permanently deletes your account, face profiles and videos. This can't be undone.

paywall.title: Get more credits
paywall.sub: Pro: monthly credits, priority queue, no watermark.
paywall.comingSoon: In-app purchases are being set up.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.insufficient_credits: You don't have enough credits for this.
errors.content_blocked: That text isn't allowed. Please try something else.
errors.rate_limited: Slow down a little and try again in a minute.
errors.too_many_active_jobs: Wait for your current videos to finish first.
errors.queue_full: We're very busy right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.profile_not_ready: Your face profile needs more photos.
errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.consent_required: Please confirm the checkboxes to continue.
errors.attestation_required: Please confirm you have the rights and everyone's consent.
errors.person_not_selectable: That person can't be replaced in this video.
errors.template_unavailable: This template is being updated, try again soon.
errors.speaker_mapping_required: It's unclear who is speaking or singing in this video. Turn lip-sync off and try again.
